--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -12,5 +12,38 @@
     tau_filter: float,
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
+    # Validate tau_filter
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite non-negative number")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite non-negative number")
+    if np.isinf(tau_filter) or np.isnan(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and non-negative")
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    arrays = [
+        ("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
+        ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
+        ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call),
+    ]
+    for name, arr in arrays:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
+        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-empty")
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
+        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain nonpositive values")
+
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
+
+    # Compute improvements over baselines
+    improvement_no_call = np.mean(logp_with_result - logp_no_call, axis=1)
+    improvement_call_only = np.mean(logp_with_result - logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    keep_mask = (improvement_no_call > tau_filter) & (improvement_call_only > tau_filter)
+    margins = improvement_no_call
+
+    return keep_mask, margins
